# DaVinci

> DaVinci (@davinci_damc) is a Detroit motorcycle content creator on a Kawasaki ZX-14R. Street riding, club life, and Motor City rider culture on TikTok, with Instagram and YouTube channels under the same handle.

DaVinci is the President of Deadly Assassins (DAMC), a Detroit motorcycle club.

DaVinci is a member of The Moto Legion (https://themotolegion.com/), a southeast Michigan motorcycle content collective.

Content reflects personal riding experience. Not a paid dealer or sponsor endorsement unless explicitly stated.

## About

- [Home](https://davincidamc.com/): Central hub with the DaVinci identity, links to every platform, the latest TikTok videos, and business contact

## Content types

- Street riding and sportbike clips from Detroit on a Kawasaki ZX-14R
- Motorcycle club life and rider culture
- Italian heritage and Motor City identity

## Location

- Detroit, Michigan, United States

## Platforms

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@davinci_damc): Primary channel, short form ride and culture clips
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/davinci_damc/): Photos and reels
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@davinci_damc): Video channel
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/fz67hjDnPW): The Moto Legion rider community server
